narrative:
## Handover Summary — Lifting Cost & Royalties

Cost drivers validated for purchased crude, royalties, lifting, refining, freight and carbon.

## Key Decisions
• Royalty tier re-run at the USD 72 planning deck (−USD 1.3B cost of sales)
• Freight re-baselined to USD 52,000/day for export cargoes (+USD 0.25B)
• Offshore lifting cost reset to USD 4.60/boe for the turnaround month

## Recommendation for Headcount Phase
Phase gas expansion hiring to the Al-Rimal commissioning dates so field operating cost does not run ahead of volume.
